Laurey 87920, T-Knob Melrose in Matte Black

The Matte Black Melrose T-Knob matches the Melrose Matte Black Cabinet Bar Pull for a complete, modern kitchen remodel. The Melrose Matte Black 2 Inch Pull has a sleek design and a beautiful finish color. This kitchen cabinet pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 87920 Melrose Matte Black T-Knob:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Length: 2"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.
